dict.string: Glyth reads your sleep, heart-rate variability, resting heart rate and workouts to adapt your day. This data stays private to you and is never shared with your employer.
Glyth uses your calendar to understand fixed commitments and protect important time.
Glyth can add focus and recovery blocks to your calendar only when you confirm.
